title: Remove the duplicated V4 product source docs/guards/v4 from IFX
goal: Remove the 169 obsolete-after-gate files of docs/guards/v4 after the T7 consumer gate, prove no live reference remains, V3 and the IFX application are unchanged, IFX consumes the exact Guard release from a clean environment and the P10.3 successor rollback still works, and record a cleanup receipt with the rollback commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly the 169 classified files, two ignored fixture files and three stale .gitignore lines are removed.
No live reference to docs/guards/v4 remains outside historical Plans, evidence and migration records.
V3, V3_ifx, .github and the IFX application are byte-identical and the application builds and passes its tests.
IFX consumes the exact V4 Guards 1.1.5 release from a clean environment and the post-cleanup Pre passes.
The P10.3 successor rollback rehearsal passes after cleanup with all negative controls rejected.
The cleanup receipt sets ifxCoreSourceRemoved true and records the rollback commit.
risks: A live consumer or harness could still read product source from docs/guards/v4.
A broad deletion could remove IFX-owned adoption records or evidence.
The accepted C6c Linux leg installs V4 from the Target's docs/guards/v4 and would fail on its next run.
decisions: Keep the deletion in a single cleanup commit so that one revert restores the source.
Keep historical Plans and evidence unchanged and classify their references as historical.
Do not edit the accepted C6c scripts; track the installer coupling as IFX-V4-003 for the next C6c successor.
Allow cleanup in the successor rehearsal only when the T8 cleanup receipt exists.
